resources.string: One silent line after each surprise toot
Your pals are tooting you awake. Toot time starts now.

string-array.name: news_loud
string-array.item: %1$s: yep, that was loud. Check your title.
BREAKING: %1$s drops a GRAET one in the meeting

string-array.name: news_soft
string-array.item: %1$s: just a little buzz. Nobody knows.

string-array.name: nag_frozen
string-array.item: %1$s: when do I get out? Waiting %2$d hours now
Bailed out for %2$d hours… you okay down there?
Holding it is riskier. Hit Back in!
Bailed out %2$d hours. U R the best at holding

string-array.name: nag_rest
string-array.item: %1$s: chicken hours, so holding it… really holding it…

string-array.name: news_hold
string-array.item: %1$s: silent mode, so I held it. Not next time.
EXCLUSIVE: %1$s blocked by silent mode, holds it in
%1$s: held it in. Are you genious?
